hypotheses.claim: CURRENT G9 can be brought into deterministic parser alignment without semantic redesign by explicit operator additions plus source normalization of prose-like relations.
hypotheses.falsifier: A complete generated parser still cannot parse normalized G9 without new semantic constructs, or normalization changes canonical meaning.

hypotheses.claim: Allowing arbitrary identifier-as-infix syntax is superior to strict normalization.
hypotheses.falsifier: Generic-infix parser shows ambiguous/nonstable AST or worse mutation/repair outcomes than strict syntax.

hypotheses.claim: Existing records/deltas/provenance/effect boundaries suffice to express the mandatory adaptive visual learner without a new semantic primitive.
hypotheses.falsifier: Executable MVC application requires an untyped escape hatch or cannot preserve promotion/rollback/version/provenance semantics.

negative_results.claim: The prior union+if parser patch is not sufficient for representative CURRENT G9 syntax; 9/10 raw representative cases fail in the local proxy.
